doc: Colour balance (Photoshop style): per tonal range (shadows / midtones / highlights) a shift along cyan-red, magenta-green and yellow-blue (-100..100 %; positive = more red / green / blue, negative = more cyan / magenta / yellow). With L = Rec.709 luma of the straight colour: weights ws = (1-L)^2, wh = L^2, wm = 1 - ws - wh = 2 L (1-L) (they sum to 1). out = clamp(c + 0.5 * sum_range w_range * (cyanRed, magentaGreen, yellowBlue) / 100) per channel (a +100 shift at full weight adds 0.5). With `preserveLuminosity` the result is offset by (L(c) - L(out)) per channel so the Rec.709 luma stays the same (then clamped). Alpha unchanged.
noop: shadowsCyanRed == 0 && shadowsMagentaGreen == 0 && shadowsYellowBlue == 0 && midtonesCyanRed == 0 && midtonesMagentaGreen == 0 && midtonesYellowBlue == 0 && highlightsCyanRed == 0 && highlightsMagentaGreen == 0 && highlightsYellowBlue == 0
